subject: Re: Status - scope cut agreed, and privacy timing
body:
Halima - agreed, and thank you for saying it in April rather than in the June retro.

Scope cut, effective now: no framework. We deliver (a) the reproduced state-level model as a reference implementation, (b) a design-pattern write-up on wiring learnable encoders into a conservation-constrained model, and (c) exactly one worked port - Milan's queue-depth forecast. If a second team wants the pattern they read the doc and copy the 200 lines. That is a fine outcome.

Kofi - the privacy review is on the reference implementation only, since the ported use case touches no health data at all. That should shorten the SLA on your side; can you confirm we're clear before Jun 1?

Alina, no staffing change, I just want Milan's port finished properly rather than three ports done badly.

Dmitri
